# Page types and intent

Use this to pick format before you set word-count targets. Wrong format wastes the scrape.

## Types

| Type | Typical query | Winner format on SERP | HVAC USA job | no-slop-copy mode |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| pdp | Lennox or Trane model number + “for sale” | Product page + specs + compatible outdoor/indoor | Get the right SKU in cart or on a call | pdp |
| collection | “Trane heat pumps,” “Lennox 3 ton AC condenser,” “Brand gas furnace” | Category with filters, short intro, product grid | First screen = our range + filter + phone; then call if the job is a design | collection / landing |
| money-page | “3 ton heat pump system,” “R454B AC condenser” | Hybrid — short commercial page or long guide + products | Rank, then call or collection click | collection / landing |
| educational | “what is a heat pump,” “R454B vs R410A” | Long guide | Pre-sell design call; do not bury the CTA | long |
| comparison | “Lennox vs Trane” (no brand-vs-brand price claims), “heat pump vs AC and furnace” | Side-by-side guide | Steer to the right catalog + warranty path | long |
| local | city + equipment, “HVAC store near me” | GBP + local landing | HVAC USA: **no-build** (ships online, no confirmed visit location). Legacy Timonium / Baltimore showroom queries belong to Got Ductless, CONFIRM with Adam | — |
| faq | “does a heat pump need a line set” | FAQ or short explainer | Answer, then size-on-a-call | faq or long |
| contractor | “wholesale mini splits,” “contractor mini split pricing” | Thin commercial or login wall | Fast quote, freight, matching parts | collection / landing |

## Intent → format rules

- If 3+ of the top 5 are **PDPs or collections**, brief a commercial page. Add a short FAQ block if PAA is thick. Do not brief a blog.
- If 3+ are **guides**, brief a guide with a product or call close in the first screen and again at the end.
- If the SERP is mixed, prefer the format that can convert on hvacusa.store. We sell equipment. A ranking essay with no path to a draft is a miss.
- Local intent gets a **no-build** note for HVAC USA unless the user is targeting national “near me” language that still ships. Do not spawn fake city pages.
- Model-number queries are PDPs even if a blog sits in position 4.

## Segment defaults

| Signal in the keyword | Segment |
|---|---|
| DIY, pre-charged line set (CONFIRM which DIY lines, if any, HVAC USA sells) | DIY |
| multi-zone, 3 zone, whole house, cassette + wall mix | whole-home |
| 9k / 12k / one room / bedroom / garage / sunroom | homeowner one-room |
| contractor, wholesale, lot, branch box bulk | contractor |
| SAM, federal, barracks, facility | federal |

## Queries that usually fail the revenue test

- Pure trivia with no buy path (“who invented the mini split”)
- Install-how-to that would require unlicensed refrigerant steps
- Medical air-purification claims
- City + keyword pages we cannot service in person

Flag these and offer a neighboring money query.
